title: On‑prem daemonset network-config drift causing nodeagent OOM/crash during staged upgrades — hotfix and playbook
creator: Priya Anand
description: During a staged on‑prem upgrade (operator 2.9.3 -> 2.9.4) several customer tenants observed nodeagent crashes and high memory growth leading to OOM kills. Root cause analysis points to divergent daemonset network overlay annotations applied by a legacy installer that conflict with the operator's post-upgrade CNI reconciliation. The conflict produces duplicated iptables chains and a small but unbounded memory leak in nodeagent's network watcher loop. This ticket coordinates an emergency hotfix release plus an operator playbook to detect and safely reconcile drift across tenants without mass rollbacks.
comments: 2026-03-10 09:12 - Priya Anand: Escalation received from Support (SUP-12458) — Acme Corp experiencing nodeagent restarts immediately after operator upgrade. Customer impact: production traffic degraded, autoscaling triggered. Triage call scheduled.

2026-03-10 10:00 - Marco Delgado: Collected logs and heap profiles from customer. Observed repeated 'netwatch: duplicate chain' warnings and unbounded memgrowth in nodeagent heap. Repro on a staging tenant using their installer manifests.

2026-03-10 13:30 - SRE (Elena Park): Short mitigation: block operator post-upgrade network reconcile by setting annotation 'redwood.operator.upgrade.network-reconcile: false' on tenant namespace; this stabilizes nodeagent but leaves underlying drift unresolved. Documented rollback steps in support runbook.

2026-03-11 08:45 - Marco Delgado: Root cause: older installer includes a Helm hook that sets 'kube-proxy' style iptables rules via a DaemonSet overlay. Operator's reconciler now expects sole ownership of overlay annotation and attempts incremental reconcile, producing duplicate chains. Fix idea: operator should detect conflicting overlay owners and perform a guarded cleanup path (two‑phase): 1) mark tenant for reconcile; 2) create a benign fence file/annotation; 3) remove legacy overlay chains only when nodeagent confirms fence present and conntrack quiescence.

2026-03-11 11:20 - Priya Anand: Security review flagged removal of iptables chains — require explicit check for 'owner' annotation and customer opt-in for automatic remediation. Added 'security_review_required: true' to metadata. Contacted Legal for approval timeline.

2026-03-11 16:05 - Marco Delgado: Implemented prototype in branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/operator/compare/hotfix/netoverlay-guard. Unit tests added for fence semantics. Heap regression test added to e2e upgrade harness.

2026-03-12 09:00 - SRE: Validated prototype on canary tenant (internal test cluster) with synthetic drift manifests. Nodeagent stayed healthy, no memgrowth. Observability query: nodeagent_heap_bytes_by_tenant shows stable curve.

2026-03-12 14:40 - Support (Karen Li): Communicated staged mitigation to affected customers: provide opt-in hotpatch document and one-time remediation window. Customers approved for automated remediation: Acme Corp, BaseLine Inc.

2026-03-13 07:55 - Marco Delgado: Opened PR for hotfix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/operator/pull/4271. Includes: guarded overlay cleanup, fence annotation implementation, idempotent rollback steps, increased network watcher backoff to avoid tight loops.

2026-03-13 12:10 - QA (Mateo Ruiz): Regression suite run: passed upgrade e2e for sequence lengths up to 4096, nightlies queued for 24h load. Noted small flake when nodeagent restart latency > 30s; added additional readiness probe check.

2026-03-14 09:30 - Priya Anand: Release plan: promote PR to operator-2.9.4-hotfix branch, publish patch notes, and coordinate 2‑hour remediation windows with customers. Drafted playbook and support runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OP/Onprem+Network+Overlay+Drift+Playbook.

2026-03-14 11:00 - Marco Delgado: Post-deploy monitoring dashboards: added templated Grafana panel 'nodeagent.heap.by_tenant' and alert 'NodeagentHeapGrowth' thresholded at 2x baseline over 10m. Pager policy: P0 on-call for first 4 hours after remediation window.

2026-03-14 15:45 - Priya Anand: Customer follow-up: Acme Corp reports pod restarts ceased after remediation, CPU and tail latencies back to normal. Schedule a retrospective and permanent fix tracked under PM roadmap.

2026-03-14 16:30 - Marco Delgado: Next steps: merge PR, cut hotfix build, publish installer compatibility checker that flags legacy overlay annotations during preflight. Owner: Marco (engineer), SRE to run canary remediation, Support to coordinate customer windows.
